title: One British watchmaker built the escapement Omega now uses in almost every mechanical watch.
hook: Story behind the co-axial escapement, from George Daniels to Omega's 1999 first movement and 2007 Co-Axial calibre.
why: Verified subject, Dial-style tension hook. Caveat: sources disagree on the invention date (1974 vs 1976, patent 1980), so the story should say 'the 1970s' or check one date. Omega's own account is promotional.

hard_gate_failures: Story test: slides 4 and 5 say the same thing
